children: ​RBC BlueBay ​Asset Management sees some value in ​five-year U.S. Treasurys as they have approached 5% ​yields,​ says fixed income CIO Mark Dowding in a note. However, RBC BlueBay remains "more circumspect" regarding longer-dated maturities​, he says. Ongoing heavy debt issuance volumes from governments and corporates continue to pressure term premia globally and from this point of view, ​RBC BlueBay is disinclined to extend beyond intermediate maturities.​ (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
